articles.title: No UP govt jobs for those involved in violent activities seeking ‘regime change’
articles.summary: The Uttar Pradesh government has updated its character verification rules for selected candidates in direct recruitment. Candidates involved in violent activities aiming for regime change could be denied government jobs.

articles.title: Kerala Judge named accused in son’s fatal Mercedes crash gets anticipatory bail
articles.summary: The Kerala High Court provided interim protection from arrest to an additional district judge involved in a fatal accident. His 17-year-old son allegedly drove a car during the incident in Kochi.

Michigan appeals court upholds $9.7 million verdict after mother dies following tummy tuck surgery
articles.summary: In a landmark decision, a Michigan court has affirmed a nearly $9.7 million ruling against Henry Ford Macomb Hospital for negligence that led to Cathleen Allen's tragic death after cosmetic surgery complications. Medical testimony highlighted that prompt action could have preserved her life.

articles.title: Gerard Butler visited Liberia in 2013; Mary’s Meals has delivered 260 million meals since 2006
articles.summary: Gerard Butler is a passionate advocate for Mary's Meals, an organization dedicated to providing vital school meals for children in Liberia. Since its launch in 2006, the charity has served over 260 million meals, making a meaningful difference in children's nutrition and education.

articles.title: Summerhouse Use Under Review: Jason Statham seeks lawful status for guest annexe; 1973 rule under scrutiny
articles.summary: Jason Statham and Rosie Huntington-Whiteley are facing challenges in planning the summerhouse at their Hampshire estate. They have submitted a request for a certificate of lawfulness to transform the structure, initially approved as a swimming-pool pavilion, into residential quarters.

articles.title: Australian couple postpone wedding to build dream castle; 22 years later, it remains unfinished
articles.summary: An Australian couple who postponed their wedding to build a fairytale castle in Tasmania are still working on it 22 years later. Christina Kent and Francis Shepherd have used around 100,000 bricks to construct the 27-room Castle Phoenix, which stands 17 metres tall.

articles.summary: IBPS recruitment 2026: IBPS has opened applications for Server Administrator, Assistant and Programming Assistant positions at its Mumbai office under Advertisement No. IBPS/2026-27/06.

articles.title: Tamil Nadu declares holiday on November 9 for schools, colleges and government offices
articles.summary: Tamil Nadu holiday November 9: The Tamil Nadu government has declared November 9 a holiday for government offices, public sector undertakings, schools, colleges and educational institutions across the state. The decision follows requests from students, parents, teachers and government employees travelling home for Deepavali on November 8.

articles.title: Karnataka schools directed to celebrate Kannada Rajyotsava on November 1 despite Sunday holiday
articles.summary: Kannada Rajyotsava 2026: The Karnataka School Education and Literacy Department has directed all government, aided and unaided primary and high schools to celebrate Kannada Rajyotsava on November 1, 2026, despite the date falling on a Sunday. An October 15 circular instructs schools to observe state and national festivals on their designated dates without postponement due to holidays.

articles.title: Karnataka proposes ban on coaching for under-15s, caps daily classes at five hours
articles.summary: Karnataka has proposed draft rules to regulate private coaching centres, barring students under 15 or those who have not completed Class 10 from enrolling. The rules cap daily coaching at five hours, restrict operating hours to 6 am-9 pm and prohibit classes during school or college hours.

articles.title: Preity Zinta’s Karwa Chauth; actor jokes moon is missing
articles.summary: Preity Zinta, currently in the US, is observing Karwa Chauth for husband Gene Goodenough but couldn’t spot the moon through cloudy skies. She asked fans on X if the moon had disappeared.

articles.title: ‘Jailer’: Rajinikanth’s 2023 film may get a black-and-white version
articles.summary: Rajinikanth's 'Jailer' franchise is making a significant mark, emerging as the top-grossing film in Tamil cinema history. Cinematographer Vijay Karthik Kannan has teased an intriguing idea for a black-and-white rendition of the film.

articles.title: Mouli says ‘Donga Naa Koduku’ song pushed him out of his comfort zone
articles.summary: Actor Mouli is set to captivate audiences with his upcoming Telugu film 'Donga Naa Koduku,' scheduled for release on November 13, 2026. In a candid moment, he discussed the challenges he faced while filming the dance number 'Oh My God,' crediting choreographer Sandeep Master for enhancing his skills.

articles.title: Armaan Malik On Ramayana: Singer calls surreal Rahman–Zimmer score dream project
articles.summary: In an exciting new venture, Armaan Malik has recorded the Kannada song 'Mangala Sangama' for the upcoming film Ramayana, featuring the musical brilliance of AR Rahman and Hans Zimmer. Grateful for the opportunity, Malik highlights his emotional ties with the Kannada-speaking community he's engaged with over the years.
